propositions: Candidate listing, snapshot detection, envelope building, retire-rename logic, and commit operations are reimplemented identically across three code paths (normal fold, rebuild, crash recovery) creating maintenance burden and bug-reproduction risk.

The snapshot envelope builder and retired-source rename-back rule each appear twice in production code (compact_txn vs compact_rebuild, and compact_txn vs compact_recovery) differing only in naming/inlining despite identical semantics.

A consolidated planner module routing all three paths through shared derivations eliminates duplication while preserving distinct crash models: fold retains abort-and-rollback journal semantics, rebuild keeps its per-file tolerance and .snapshot-rebuild.bak sentinel, and fsck owns mixed-state recovery.
Stray non-.json files in ticket directories are cited in source_event_uuids and retired by rebuild today; converged list_candidates requires .json suffix, making behavior more strict and consistent.
